paragraphs: EasyMile makes autonomous driving software for vehicles working at airports, logistics sites and industrial sites around the world. The company supplies the autonomous driving intelligence, a CE-marked stack handling perception, path planning and safety. The vehicles it powers are distributed by TractEasy.

One of them is a heavy-duty autonomous tow tractor built for airports, factories and logistics hubs. It is described as running around the clock with a single operator overseeing an entire fleet. The other is a cargo dolly for air cargo and ground handling operations. It carries up to 7 metric tonnes while navigating around personnel and ground equipment. The software is meant to be modular enough to power other kinds of heavy-duty vehicles as well.

EasyMile says it was founded in 2014 between Singapore and Toulouse. Its timeline starts with a first passenger fleet on the road in Lausanne, Switzerland. The same timeline names Alstom, Bpifrance and Continental as investors backing the company. It records driving in autonomous mode in more than 300 locations worldwide. The company also claims to be the first autonomous technology provider to obtain ISO 9001:2015 certification.

quote.text: Intelligent software to move heavy loads
